availability_truthfulness.current_statement: The assistant conversation is unavailable through this release surface; no model readiness is inferred from an installed artifact.
availability_truthfulness.safe_diagnostics: M7-06 remains an in-memory service. Its future publication must use the frozen same-origin status API only after the M10 request-security blocker is closed.
availability_truthfulness.no_dead_control: At M10-01 completion the entry had no button, composer, install action, retry action, status poll or chat endpoint. M10-02 may add only visibly disabled inert controls until the request-security gates are closed.

security_and_resource_boundaries.reason: AI093-T05 remains a release blocker. M10-01 therefore adds no assistant request surface before body, schema, same-origin and CSRF controls are composed and tested.
